page: Amazon Web Services t8i.nano is a burstable performance instance belonging to the t8i server family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel processor running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 virtual CPUs mapped to a single physical core with 2 threads per core, utilizing the Nitro hypervisor to manage virtualization overhead.

The hardware allocation includes 0.5 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 0.25 GB per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU hardware. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

From a resource density and cost-efficiency perspective, the t8i.nano is positioned as an economical entry-level tier. Because it uses a burstable CPU allocation model, it is designed for workloads that remain idle or experience low baseline CPU utilization with occasional spikes. Suitable workloads include lightweight microservices, basic testing environments, simple cron jobs, and low-traffic development utilities.
